notes.title: Game will be full released at 3:30 p.m. on January 14
notes.content:
Thank you for your attention. I'm glad to inform you that the game will be officially released at 3:30 p.m. on January 14!
After this release, there will be some changes to the following elements, please take attention:
1. The workshop function is temporarily blocked. At present, due to some problems, the workshop cannot be used normally. Please use [url] first= https://store.steampowered.com/widget/1485130/]DLC [/url] to experience the game. Access: click Install directly.
2. The official version will soon launch a restart experience policy. (you will get some training props at the beginning of the restart)
3. We're going to launch the next two gilrs' DLC.
4. We will launch a slightly bloody and violent war break DLC, players can carefully choose to start.

Finally, thank you for your attention to the game. Your support is our greatest encouragement. If you think the game is fun, please give us a review so that more players can see her. Thank you~

notes.title: Recent reports
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
